Full-manifest type/count/byte validation before content opens
Root/intermediate/leaf symlink refusal, regular-file-only, nlink=1, same device as root
Owned handle pre/post stat; bounded size+1 allocation; explicit-position short-read loop
Fatal UTF8 decode with BOM preserved and byte roundtrip; reject NUL binary
Explicit close with refusal on uncertainty and prior error code retention
Immutable byte-bound snapshot and capture observation, NOT_RUN and authorizing false
implementation.platformDeclaration: Darwin/Linux POSIX code path; only actual macOS arm64 runtime validated
nonClaims: verified local mount or absence of concurrent writers
secret screening or anonymity from root hash
execution permission or model disclosure consent
